lessons.name: 01 · What a drone is made of
lessons.summary: Start with the frame and work outward.

source.title: X500 V2 Kits
source.locator: SKU 30125 · Specifications and Package Includes

body: An airframe holds propulsion, controls, energy storage, and the payload in place. In a kit, the items in the package and the items needed to fly can be different. The X500 V2 SKU 30125 is a useful example because its package contents are listed.
Open the teardown and choose the frame or a motor. Compare the part list with the source and look for what the kit does not include.

lessons.name: 02 · How a drone flies

source.title: Propeller Thrust
source.locator: Propeller propulsion system and momentum model

body: A propeller increases the momentum of the air passing through it. That produces thrust. A multirotor must produce enough upward force to balance its weight in hover.
Change the mass and thrust in the propulsion lab. Then compare a quadcopter with a fixed-wing entry. The useful performance conditions are different.

lessons.name: 03 · Motors, batteries, and endurance
lessons.summary: Connect electrical energy to flight time.

source.title: Lithium-Ion Battery Recycling
source.locator: Background on Lithium Batteries; recycling and reuse sections

body: The battery stores electrical energy and the motors draw power from it. If average power were constant, usable watt-hours divided by watts would give the time in hours.
Test the effect of a higher reserve in the lab. Treat the result as a model under the stated load, because power changes with maneuvering, wind and payload.

lessons.name: 04 · Sensors and flight control
lessons.summary: Follow the commands from a controller to the aircraft.

source.title: PX4 Architectural Overview
source.locator: Flight stack, middleware and hardware

body: The flight stack combines sensor information and estimates how the aircraft is moving. Controllers use that estimate to generate commands, and the mixer or allocator turns those into outputs.
A board, the firmware it runs, and its attached sensors are separate entries. Follow a controller part to the representative silicon pathway.

lessons.name: 05 · Cameras and other payloads
lessons.summary: See how the mission changes the aircraft.

source.title: Matrice 350 RTK Specifications
source.locator: Gimbal, supported payloads, and aircraft specifications

body: The payload is what the aircraft carries to do the job. A mapping camera needs different settings from a thermal camera. An aircraft may have specific mechanical and electrical interfaces for compatible payloads.
Open the survey lab. Increase side overlap and observe how narrower line spacing changes the idealized coverage rate.

lessons.name: 06 · From material to assembly
lessons.summary: Follow the stages behind a component.

source.title: Neodymium Magnets Supply Chain Deep Dive Assessment
source.locator: Supply Chain Mapping and stages of NdFeB magnet production

body: A rare earth mine, separation plant, metal producer, and magnet factory do different jobs. A map of production at one stage cannot tell you where every later stage happens.
Open the magnet chain and cut the separation step. Compare the modeled dependency with the actual claims linked from the X500 motor.

lessons.name: 07 · Aircraft, operators, and rules
lessons.summary: Understand how an aircraft becomes a service.

source.title: Package Delivery by Drone (Part 135)
source.locator: Approved operators, aircraft and operations

body: An aircraft model and the organization operating it are distinct. The FAA’s delivery page associates specific operators with approved operations and aircraft. Equipment declarations and flight permissions answer different questions.
Start with a delivery aircraft and follow the operator or regulator link. Check its jurisdiction and publication before generalizing to another mission.

lessons.name: 08 · Repair, reuse, and recycling
lessons.summary: Follow the aircraft after it is sold.

source.title: Lithium-Ion Battery Recycling
source.locator: Background on Lithium Batteries; recycling and reuse sections

body: The aircraft, battery, and payload may enter different repair or recovery streams. Lithium-ion batteries contain materials that specialist processes can recover. Ask the manufacturer or local waste authority about appropriate disposal for a damaged pack.
Compare two aircraft and see which service relationships are documented. Check the atlas for public recycling facilities and the date on each status claim.
